author: श्रीमदानन्दतीर्थभगवत्पादाचार्य
commentary: इतश्च योगाय युज्यस्व इत्याह - दूरेणेति ॥ बुद्धियोगाद् ज्ञानलक्षणाद् उपायाद् । दूरेण अतीव । अतो बुद्धौ शरणं ज्ञाने स्थितिम् । फलं कर्मकृतौ हेतुर्येषां ते फलहेतवः ॥ ४९ ॥
translation: For this reason as well...Krishna says, 'Prepare yourself for this Yoga!' by uttering the words.....Dūreṇa (by a great distance / far inferior). Krishna clarifies that Buddhi-yogād means: 'Compared to the practical method (upāya) which is characterized by spiritual knowledge (jñāna).' Dūreṇa means atīva—exceedingly or far inferior (referring to selfish actions). Therefore, buddhau śaraṇam means...take firm, unshakeable shelter and station yourself strictly inside this spiritual knowledge. Those for whom the expected reward (phalam) is the sole driving motive or cause (hetu) for doing an action are called Phala-hetavaḥ (reward-seekers or calculators of profit).
